title: Around the world without stopping
text: The Rutan Voyager, the first aircraft to fly around the world nonstop and unrefueled, was built in Mojave. Dick Rutan and Jeana Yeager flew it in December 1986.

s1.title: Mojave, California
s1.quote: The town was home to the Rutan Voyager, the first aircraft to fly around the world nonstop and unrefueled.

s2.title: Rutan Voyager
s2.publisher: Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum
s2.quote: On December 23, 1986, Voyager completed the first nonstop, non-refueled flight around the world. ... Pilots Dick Rutan and Jeana Yeager ... built at Mojave Airport, California
